title: Not sure
content: Hey all, I just discovered this sub and I am hoping for some clarity! Though my reoccurring dreams aren’t mall themed, they are ship themed. Always cruise ships, usually they are old ships but they’re always in bad shape. And by bad shape I mean a disaster or something catastrophic happened to it. always while I’m in these ships, I’m wandering searching and looking for a way out but it never arrives. There was one dream where the ship was sinking and full of water, but I was just casually paddling through the ship in a canoe, searching for a way out. If it’s not a ship, then it’s in an abandoned school or what feels like a castle of some sort. These dreams happen weekly, and they always leave me confused and feeling very very lost. Just wanted to share, and if anybody knows of a different sub that’s similar please send it my way. Thanks all. Hope you’re well rested.
